prose: Modern healthcare treats symptoms, but what if illness begins at a deeper level most systems ignore? Naturopath Nicholas Leach joins InnerVerse to explore terrain theory, trauma, consciousness, and the true foundations of healing. Our conversation shines light on the root causes of health issues, the limitations of germ theory, and the importance of terrain and worldview healing. Discover how natural laws, electromagnetic fields, and emotional health influence overall well-being.
ext: Hour two carries us towards exploring health, herbs, consciousness, and the interconnectedness of body, mind, and spirit, including practical approaches for resolving trauma and hypersensitivity. We also get into the teaching power of plants and healing abilities of sound.
